_about: Career Companion Hub's neutral, ATS-safe layout: single column, standard headings, a Summary only when one is written, one Skills line plus a Tools line, Experience, Consulting & Advisory only when present, Education, Certifications. Built into hub/template/docx_template.json by make_template.py --layout; the theme keys colour the run styles and the heading rule, and style.center_lines=false keeps the Skills and Tools lines left-aligned.
